item.title: I'll never buy Framework hardware again
item.description:
TL;DR:
This post ended up on Hacker News and got a lot more attention than I expected. I’m not trying to hurt Framework; I want them to fix their support. I want them to give us what we paid for, a working laptop.

ENODRAMA. Move along, there’s nothing to see here anymore.

I take short consulting engagements — architecture review, technical due diligence, mail infrastructure — through aljuna.tech.
